author: sarariman1985
quote: GTA used to be a game that made fun of everyone and everything. GTA used to be unhinged. You could do whatever you wanted. I played GTA ever since the first one on PC long ago. This cannot be called GTA, its just a politically correct, morally correct action game. If it wouldn't be called GTA it wouldn't receive this kind of backlash. No this GTA is garbage. Save your money.
